label: live-demo
alert: High p95 latency on frontend: 13050.0 ms (baseline 4738.6 ms)
summary: The frontend service is slow because the product-catalog service is resource-starved and unhealthy, leading to high latency in product catalog operations.
symptoms: High p95 latency on frontend (10389.7 ms)
Unhealthy product-catalog container with frequent restarts

root_cause.description: The product-catalog service is resource-starved, with very low memory limits (20MiB) causing it to become unhealthy and slow, which in turn causes high latency in the frontend service.

evidence.explanation: The frontend service is experiencing high p95 latency (10389.7 ms) due to slow calls to the product-catalog service. Traces show that the product-catalog service is taking over 7 seconds to respond to ListProducts requests.

The product-catalog container is unhealthy and has been restarting frequently (8 times). It is experiencing high CPU usage (67.27% of one core) and memory pressure (frequent spikes near the 20MiB limit).
The product-catalog service is struggling with database queries, which are taking significant time, contributing to the overall latency.

ruled_out: The checkout service is also unhealthy, but it is a downstream effect of the product-catalog latency and its own resource constraints, not the primary cause of the frontend latency. The payment service restarts were previous remediation actions and are not the current root cause.

proposed_action.reason: the runbook has no approved action for 'resource_starvation'; escalating to a human

prevention: Increase the memory and CPU limits for the product-catalog service to handle the load and prevent OOM-like behavior or resource starvation. Investigate if the database queries can be optimized.
